title: Depth-zero AC circuits lie in NC
statement: If a language over Boolean strings is recognized by a well-formed family of Boolean circuits of polynomial size and depth at most a constant times $(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)^0$ on inputs of length $n$, then it is recognized by a family of Boolean circuits with at most two inputs per gate, of polynomial size and depth at most a constant times $(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)^1$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over Boolean strings
$L$ has a well-formed circuit family of polynomial size
That family has polylogarithmic depth with exponent $0$
